title: Concrete masonry units.
officialText: Concrete masonry units shall conform to the following standards: ASTM C 55 for concrete brick; ASTM C 73 for calcium silicate face brick; ASTM C 90 for load-bearing concrete masonry units; ASTM C 129 for nonload-bearing concrete masonry units or ASTM C 744 for prefaced concrete and calcium silicate masonry units.
